propositions: Core implements five CAS push-first retry cycles followed by exactly one conditional terminal push, with retriable non-fast-forward rejection triggering fetch-and-merge recovery only when needed

Strict delivery raises catchable PushDeliveryError with stable reasons and detail, translated to stderr plus nonzero exit only by the Python module adapter, with no event emission or BRIDGE_ALERT generated

All pre-existing library, CLI, MCP, and store-write callers retain best-effort default behavior (strict=False) and inherit only the corrected five-cycle plus one-terminal-push retry budget without breaking changes
Strict failure distinct reasons separate policy declines (GH013/branch protection markers) from transport failures (timeout/network), with both carrying git detail and unpushed-commit count

Caller contract matrix covers event append, batch append, import, close, delete, compact, and claim paths, each verifying omission of strict or explicit strict=False preservation of legacy return disposition
